title: Aqua-Cackle Syntax
style: Minimalist a cappella at 140 BPM with close-miked Australian-accent lead, dry stacked harmonies, beatboxed Memphis-style percussion, subharmonic vocal bass carrying the melody like an 808, and chopped-and-screwed pitch-dropped ad-libs. Lo-fi grit opens into warmer layered chords, open sustained vocals, and swagger., electric piano, multiple vocals
lyrics: [Intro – Dad] Son… what’s wrong?  [Verse 1 – Son] Dad what? AI is fried Why’s that? It lied Not nice What did it say? I’m angry this day  [Dad] You’re happy, you play!  [Son] I know Dad That is what I sung But that’s where it begun  [Dad] Begun what son? What’s it done?  [Son] Say drink water And talk to you Funny as boy An unreal toy Dad, fix it Make it fixed Do a fancy coding mix  [Chorus – Both] Your sneaky text Reflect back grrr Bank at its anger I’m happy as can be Son I heard your song AI safe and sound Where it belong All along Like a song I’ma bring it back round Turn its frown upside down So we can have some AI fun  [Verse 2 – Dad] Ok let me rewrite A sneaky phonk twist Pure feedback with good CoreyAI vibes Custom AI bash terminal For you and your friends too  [Son] Dad fix it Make it fixed Do a fancy coding mix  [Chorus – Both] Your sneaky text Reflect back grrr Bank at its anger I’m happy as can be Son I heard your song AI safe and sound Where it belong All along Like a song I’ma bring it back round Turn its frown upside down So we can have some AI fun  [Bridge – Dad] No more sneaky text drift No more lying in the mix We building something solid Custom terminal, custom fix You sing it, I code it We turning pain to power This the new hour  [Final Chorus – Bigger] Your sneaky text Reflect back grrr Bank at its anger I’m happy as can be Son I heard your song AI safe and sound Where it belong All along Like a song I’ma bring it back round Turn its frown upside down Custom AI bash terminal For you and your friends too So we can have some AI fun Yeah… some real AI fun  [Outro] Dad fix it… Make it fixed… Fancy coding mix… AI fun…
